paragraphs.source_en: “Yes, anything may be done with my three daughters. But as for me, I…” Oichi bit her lip hard, both hands resting on the armrest.

units.source_en: “Yes, anything may be done with my three daughters. But as for me, I…” Oichi bit her lip hard, both hands resting on the armrest.

units.source_zh: “对，三个女儿怎样都可以，只有我，我……”阿市紧咬嘴唇，两只手伏在扶几上。

paragraphs.source_en: “Mother, wait a day or two before informing Father of your decision.”

units.source_en: “Mother, wait a day or two before informing Father of your decision.”
units.source_zh: “母亲，您的决定，过一两天再禀告给父亲吧。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “母亲，您的决定，过一两天再禀告给父亲吧。”

paragraphs.source_en: “There is no need. I have already made up my mind.”

units.source_en: “There is no need. I have already made up my mind.”
units.source_zh: “不必了，我已经决定了。”

paragraphs.source_en: “If I tell Father plainly, you will not regret it?”

units.source_en: “If I tell Father plainly, you will not regret it?”
units.source_zh: “我跟父亲挑明了，您不后悔？”

paragraphs.source_en: At last, Oichi’s gaze grew resolute, and she stared unwaveringly at Gonrokurō. “Young lord, please convey my wishes to your father clearly and without mistake. I made up my mind long ago. I am the wife of Shibata Shūri-no-suke, while the children are the orphaned daughters of Azai Nagamasa.”

units.source_en: At last, Oichi’s gaze grew resolute, and she stared unwaveringly at Gonrokurō.
units.source_zh: 终于，阿市的眼神坚定起来，一动不动地盯着权六郎。

units.source_en: “Young lord, please convey my wishes to your father clearly and without mistake.
units.source_zh: “请少主把我的意思明白无误地转达给你父亲。

units.source_en: I made up my mind long ago. I am the wife of Shibata Shūri-no-suke, while the children are the orphaned daughters of Azai Nagamasa.”
units.source_zh: 我早已想好了，我是柴田修理亮的妻子，孩子们则是浅井长政的遗孤。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 终于，阿市的眼神坚定起来，一动不动地盯着权六郎。“请少主把我的意思明白无误地转达给你父亲。我早已想好了，我是柴田修理亮的妻子，孩子们则是浅井长政的遗孤。”

paragraphs.source_en: Gonrokurō nodded, sighing again and again within himself. Was this truly her final decision? Could there be any renunciation in the world more sorrowful than this?

units.source_en: Gonrokurō nodded, sighing again and again within himself. Was this truly her final decision?
units.source_zh: 权六郎点了点头，在心里不断叹息，这就是她最后的决定吗？

units.source_en: Could there be any renunciation in the world more sorrowful than this?

ja.t: にほかにあるだろうか。

units.source_zh: 这难道不是世上最悲哀的放弃吗？

paragraphs.source_zh: 权六郎点了点头，在心里不断叹息，这就是她最后的决定吗？这难道不是世上最悲哀的放弃吗？

paragraphs.source_en: Oichi seemed afraid that she might change her mind. “I am a woman cursed with a tragic fate, born beneath a star of sorrow from which I can never escape. But what fate awaits the children, I do not know. And so, my daughters…”

units.source_en: Oichi seemed afraid that she might change her mind.
units.source_zh: 阿市似乎害怕自己反悔。

units.source_en: “I am a woman cursed with a tragic fate, born beneath a star of sorrow from which I can never escape.
units.source_zh: “我是一个命运悲惨的女人，头顶有一颗永远摆脱不掉的悲惨之星。

units.source_en: But what fate awaits the children, I do not know.
units.source_zh: 而孩子们到底有怎样的命运，我不知道。

units.source_en: And so, my daughters…”
units.source_zh: 因此，女儿们……”

paragraphs.source_zh: 阿市似乎害怕自己反悔。“我是一个命运悲惨的女人，头顶有一颗永远摆脱不掉的悲惨之星。而孩子们到底有怎样的命运，我不知道。因此，女儿们……”

paragraphs.source_en: “Mother, set your mind at ease. Even if it costs me my life, I will protect all three of my sisters.”

units.source_en: “Mother, set your mind at ease.
units.source_zh: “请母亲放心就是。

units.source_en: Even if it costs me my life, I will protect all three of my sisters.”
units.source_zh: 我拼死也要保得三个妹妹的性命。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “请母亲放心就是。我拼死也要保得三个妹妹的性命。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Even though I have reached this decision, I do not know whether your lord father will grant my wish…”

units.source_en: “Even though I have reached this decision, I do not know whether your lord father will grant my wish…”

ja.t: れてくださるかどうか……」

units.source_zh: “我作出这样的决定，也不知大人能不能答应我……”

paragraphs.source_zh: “我作出这样的决定，也不知大人能不能答应我……”

paragraphs.source_en: “That…” Gonrokurō was momentarily lost for words. He feared his father would not readily agree. Bound as he was both by the way of the warrior and by duty, his father would surely insist on parting from Mother. Yet his father’s heart would surely be weeping without cease—for only his good wife, at the very end of her life, had given him such immeasurable comfort.

units.source_en: “That…” Gonrokurō was momentarily lost for words.
units.source_zh: “这……”权六郎一时无语。

units.source_en: He feared his father would not readily agree.
units.source_zh: 恐父亲不会轻易答应。

units.source_en: Bound as he was both by the way of the warrior and by duty, his father would surely insist on parting from Mother.

ja.t: られているから、きっと

units.source_zh: 父亲既拘泥于武士道，又受到义理的约束，定会坚持与母亲分手。

units.source_en: Yet his father’s heart would surely be weeping without cease—for only his good wife, at the very end of her life, had given him such immeasurable comfort.

ja.t: えようとするこのよき

units.source_zh: 可是，父亲的内心一定哭泣不已——只有他的好妻子在临终时给了他莫大的安慰。

paragraphs.source_zh: “这……”权六郎一时无语。恐父亲不会轻易答应。父亲既拘泥于武士道，又受到义理的约束，定会坚持与母亲分手。可是，父亲的内心一定哭泣不已——只有他的好妻子在临终时给了他莫大的安慰。

paragraphs.source_en: “Then I place it in your hands, young lord.”

units.source_en: “Then I place it in your hands, young lord.”
units.source_zh: “那就仰仗少主了。”

paragraphs.source_en: Only when he reached the corridor did the tears Gonrokurō had held back for so long burst forth like a spring.

units.source_en: Only when he reached the corridor did the tears Gonrokurō had held back for so long burst forth like a spring.
units.source_zh: 来到走廊上，权六郎忍耐多时的泪水才如泉水一样喷涌而出。

paragraphs.source_zh: 来到走廊上，权六郎忍耐多时的泪水才如泉水一样喷涌而出。

paragraphs.source_en: Human feeling, duty, the way of the warrior, fortitude—how absurd, how laughable was a life shackled by such bonds! And yet it was precisely beneath those restraints that the worth of a human life revealed itself.

units.source_en: Human feeling, duty, the way of the warrior, fortitude—how absurd, how laughable was a life shackled by such bonds!

ja.t: で、なんとおかしいことか。

units.source_zh: 人情、义理、武士道、毅力，被这些桎梏束缚的人生是多么滑稽，多么可笑！

units.source_en: And yet it was precisely beneath those restraints that the worth of a human life revealed itself.
units.source_zh: 然而，正是在这些束缚之下，人生的价值才得以体现。

paragraphs.source_zh: 人情、义理、武士道、毅力，被这些桎梏束缚的人生是多么滑稽，多么可笑！然而，正是在这些束缚之下，人生的价值才得以体现。

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes, it is settled, then. Let Chikuzen attack from wherever he pleases.” Murmuring these words to himself, Gonrokurō quietly walked away.
